nodes.title: Settings
widgets_values:
Settings:



Pixel size:
Size of the latent for the generation. Will always be square. 1024 will be 1024x1024. I recommend 1024 or higher for Anima

Expland mask:
How much the mask is expanded beyond the selection. Usually good idea to keep same as mask blur radius.

Padding:
How much image around the mask is included in the generation. Default it will add 32 pixels around the mask. If the inpainted pixel area is low, raising this can help with inconsistency or too sharp results.

Mask blur radius:
How much blur is added to the mask. Will help with no visible lines on final image. Can help keeping inconsistency of the image on higher denoise. Default 10.

Fill masked holes:
If this is enabled you can do draw around the area you want to mask and it will fill it for the mask. The area must be enclosed.

Color match:
If the color is not matching, is too light, too dark turning this to 1 can help. It will try to match the color of the image to the original image. Can help with issues when VAE/lora/prompt is changing the color. I do not recommend using color match with full gen.

Mask opacity:
Mask opacity is good setting if you want to keep the composition and want subtle change in the image, for example if you just want to refine parts of the image. lowering it to something like 0.7-0.9 and having 1 denoise will most of the time keep the composition of the image intact, but will refine the image.

nodes.title: Anima notes
widgets_values:
Anima vs sdxl on inpainting:

Anima adapts to the image better, so generally higher denoise works better than for sdxl for example. 

For anima i recommend er sde sampler and simple,beta or sgm uniform scheduler. Other than sde samplers can give blurrier images.

If you use shift with anima, i recommend compare higher and lower, too high shift can give blurrier images.

If you are using edit lora, you can lower the step amount. Lower step amounts can give better results.

With edit lora, use 1 denoise and 1 opacity.

With full gen i don't recommend using color match.

If you have problems with the workflow, you can report them in [here](https://civitai.red/models/128556/comfyui-inpaint-workflow)

nodes.title: Bypasser / muters explanation
widgets_values:
|Settings| |
|---|---|
|Enable edit| Adds ability to use edit loras. See [Anima edit](https://civitai.red/models/2650553/anima-edit) and [ComfyUI Cosmos node](https://github.com/Mirumo0u0/ComfyUI-Cosmos-Reference)|
|Enable save| Enables save node |
|Enable 1. Cut gen| Changes generation to cut mode where it cuts mask and surrounding and generates that instead of full image|
|Enable 2. Full gen| Uses full image on generation. Only masked area is changed in the image, should have minimal degradation on other parts|
